tldr: Jack Bailey gave the Fuse update: Purdy & Figg peak ran at 100% order success, Edicom connected to the SFTP for CT, and stock sync, raw payload capture, work order and pick/pack fixes are in progress.
Jitterbit parity for Shopify may start mid to late November, with no risk to the migration programme. Capacity is reserved for CT functional testing.
Darren Cobby replaced the old project plan with a smaller one: Shopify build date moved back a week, raw payload support work now end of November, CSV/JSON testing checked by the 20th.
Customer migration dates are still weeks, not dates. Darren will hold a follow-up call next week and email the group today. Only one customer has confirmed so far. Indu is due to move Monday.
Customers get roughly two weeks to engage with dev store testing before the team pivots to doing it themselves, with the CAMS now pushing customers.
decisions: Replace the old project plan with a smaller summary plan; detail stays in Jira boards.
Plan reporting will cover only customers and requirements known today, framed as customers enabled/supported, not future unknowns.
Shopify build date moved back a week after the build completion estimate; CSV status to be rechecked by the 20th; support functionality (raw payload) now end of November.
Customers get about two weeks from this week to engage with testing; after that the team does it themselves and goes live without their testing.
Customers who decline testing can go live without it, with the testing window offered as their opportunity.
